subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent context/workspace on model fallback

question: Which public fallback-context contract should OpenClaw support for this issue: switching to another agent, overriding only workspace/context, or defining model-specific context profiles?
rationale: The implementation changes public config and session/auth semantics, and automation should not choose whether fallback changes agent identity or only prompt/context assembly.

options.title: Model context profile first
options.body: Add an explicit model/fallback context profile that can control bootstrap/context budgets and possibly tools/skills while preserving the original agent/session identity.

options.title: Fallback agent switch
options.body: Allow fallback attempts to run as another configured agent, accepting the larger migration and safety work around agentDir, auth, skills, and transcript identity.

options.title: Narrow workspace/runbook override
options.body: Add a smaller fallback workspace or runbook override for graceful degradation, leaving full per-model profile identity for a later design.

recommendation.title: Model context profile first
recommendation.body: Add an explicit model/fallback context profile that can control bootstrap/context budgets and possibly tools/skills while preserving the original agent/session identity.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already kept this issue open for design and is the clearest product-direction routing candidate in the current discussion.
